params.body:
With a repair-only draft, Elixir now also sends what each hand gains (`adds`): the kinds it newly holds, to the grant or to one of its tasks, each with its layer from `REPAIR_KINDS`, and the resources it newly reaches. Portal needs this to hold a passkey approval to the owner's working set, because it holds the draft but not the grants the gateway serves (version 0 is the carried configuration).

`PolicyLog::additions()` sits beside `repairOnly()`. Hands that gain nothing are left out; a version that only takes away adds nothing.

Either deploy order is safe. Portal ignores `adds` until portal's companion PR lands, and without `adds` Portal refuses the passkey and leaves the version to the token.

Tests: `additions` on new kinds with their layers, new resources, a kind added to a task, and taking away; the repair draft carries `adds`. `php artisan test`: 731 passed. PHPStan: no errors. Pint clean.

Companion PRs: portal and control (`workbench/repair-in-working-set`).
params.title: Policy log: send what each hand gains with a repair-only draft
